description: Get detailed information for a specific short dump including full error texts, cause, and solution. Use this after sap_read_dumps to drill into a specific dump. Pass date, time, user, server, and error_id directly from the sap_read_dumps results.

date.description: Dump date in YYYYMMDD format (from sap_read_dumps 'date' field)

error_id.description: Error ID / RABAX name (from sap_read_dumps 'error_id' field). Improves error text lookup.

langu.description: Language for error texts (E=English, D=German). Defaults to system language.

time.description: Dump time in HHMMSS format (from sap_read_dumps 'time' field)

user.description: User name who caused the dump (from sap_read_dumps 'user' field)

name: sap_read_dump_details
